prompt: A narrow side street at night, brick walls closing both edges of the frame. Lens slightly above head height at 40mm: a short fat bald white man of 45 in the near foreground tilts his broad, double-chinned clean-shaven face up to us, snub nose, mouth wide, face a third of the frame's height, one arm flung sideways gripping his hat. Further back and smaller, a very tall thin Black man of 60 stands bolt upright on the kerb, long hollow face, both fists raised. Further still, a wiry Mexican American man of 20 crouches on a 1920s sedan's bonnet, head thrown back. That sedan burns against a lamp post in orange flame, under a blank bulb-edged theatre marquee whose teal light falls on the bald man's face. Thanks.
